units.summary: Microsoft 365 Copilot licences were purchased for 25 office staff as a pilot.
units.quote: Microsoft 365 Copilot licences purchased for 25 office staff in spring 2026 as a pilot.

units.summary: Use of Copilot was uneven: some employees used it daily, while others had not opened it.
units.quote: Usage is uneven: some people use it daily for emails and meeting summaries, others "have not opened it".

units.topic: Employee use of public AI tools
units.summary: Several employees used free ChatGPT for translations and drafting customer letters.
units.quote: Several employees use free ChatGPT for translations (Swedish, English, Estonian drivers) and for drafting customer letters.

units.summary: The company had no AI usage policy and had provided no training beyond a one-hour vendor webinar.
units.quote: No guidelines or training beyond a one-hour vendor webinar.

units.summary: A UiPath RPA bot matched supplier invoices to purchase orders in Business Central, handling about 70% of invoices; the notes distinguish this from AI.
units.quote: Works for ~70 % of invoices; the rest go to manual handling. This is rule-based, not AI, but it is the company's main automation experience.

units.summary: The company had no machine-learning models in production.
units.quote: No machine learning models in production.

units.summary: The company had strong operational digitalisation through its WMS, TMS and EDI, while AI use was individual and ad hoc.
units.quote: Strong operational digitalisation (WMS, TMS, EDI) but AI use is individual and ad hoc

units.summary: FAIR's preliminary AI maturity rating was Low.
units.quote: Preliminary AI maturity rating by FAIR: LOW.

units.summary: The notes cite the absence of an AI strategy, policy, roadmap and AI-specific in-house skills as reasons for the low maturity assessment.
units.quote: no strategy, policy, roadmap or AI-specific skills in house.

units.summary: The company had no data warehouse; reporting used Excel exports and a few Power BI reports maintained by the IT manager.
units.quote: No data warehouse; reporting is done in Excel exports and a few Power BI reports that Jari maintains.

units.summary: The company had no central data warehouse, and reporting relied on manual Excel exports prepared by the IT Manager.
units.quote: There is no central data warehouse. Customer master data is maintained separately in the WMS, TMS and Business Central, and there is no shared customer identifier between the systems. Reporting relies on manual Excel exports prepared by the IT Manager.

units.summary: The board-approved strategy included mapping automation and AI opportunities, running at least one measurable AI pilot in 2027, and introducing AI usage policy and training for office staff.
units.quote:
Map core processes and identify opportunities for automation and artificial intelligence (in progress, autumn 2026).
Run at least one AI pilot in 2027 with a measurable business case.
Introduce an AI usage policy and training for office staff.
